page.ahkTip: Ask AutoHotkey for today's date (LegalDate in dAHKxodus.ahk) and type it at the caret
page.macrosTip: Run an AutoHotkey macro (the scripts in the macros folder; they drive the editor through Doc.ahk)
page.hint: Click any paragraph, heading, table cell, footnote, header or footer to edit it. Enter splits a block, Backspace at the start merges it into the previous one, Ctrl+Z undoes. Select text and press New Comment to annotate it. Only the block you changed re-renders — everything else keeps full fidelity, and Save writes a lossless .docx.
page.pdfTip: Save the document's pages as a PDF

dAHKxodus didn't close normally last time. It had saved a recovery copy of "{0}" at {1}.

Yes: recover it (then save it to keep it).
No: discard the recovery copy.
Cancel: decide at the next start.
